title: Air India Offers Students 10% Off Domestic Fares; Book by October 20
excerpt: The limited-time student fare discount runs through October 20, with direct-booking perks and UPI savings on top; year-round benefits include extra baggage and one free date change.
body:
• Air India is offering students a flat 10% off domestic fares — but bookings must be made by 20 October 2026 to get the limited-period discount.
  • Eligibility: students must be at least 12 years old on the date of travel and enrolled in a full-time course of at least one academic year at a recognized institution, and must carry proof (student ID, acceptance letter, or valid student visa) at check-in.
  • Students booking directly on airindia.com or the mobile app get more: a 50% cut in convenience fees for logged-in customers, plus up to Rs 1,000 off per passenger on domestic bookings paid by UPI with promo code UPIPROMO.
  • Beyond the limited offer, Air India's year-round student programme gives up to 10% off fares, 10 kg of additional baggage, and one complimentary date change on eligible domestic and international bookings.
  • What it means for you: on a Rs 8,000 domestic fare, the limited-time offer saves roughly Rs 800; stacking direct-booking perks and the UPI code can take total savings past Rs 1,800 — real money for students flying home for Diwali.

Air India has rolled out a limited-time student offer of flat 10% off domestic fares, aimed at students planning travel during the festive season. The catch: bookings must be made by 20 October 2026 to lock in the discount.

The offer sits on top of Air India's standing student programme, which continues year-round with up to 10% off fares, 10 kg of additional baggage allowance, and one complimentary date change on eligible domestic and international bookings — the free date-change benefit answers the flexibility students most often need when academic schedules shift.

Context & Background

To qualify for student benefits on domestic travel, passengers must be at least 12 years old on the date of travel and enrolled in a full-time course lasting at least one academic year at an eligible institution — one recognized, aided by, or affiliated with a central or state government, educational board or university, or an accredited school, college or university.

Documentation matters: students must carry valid supporting documents for verification at check-in, which may include a student identity card, an acceptance letter from the institution, or a valid student visa where applicable. Failing to produce the required documents can trigger a misuse recovery amount plus applicable taxes.

Sibling carrier Air India Express is running a parallel student promotion: flat 10% savings on domestic Value fares until October 20, a total 25 kg baggage allowance (15 kg standard plus 10 kg extra), and date changes for just Rs 99 — a separate offer on a separate airline, not combinable with the mainline deal.

Impact & Analysis

The timing is aimed squarely at the festive travel rush. The extra 10 kg of baggage is the quiet workhorse of the programme — useful for students moving between home and campus with a semester's worth of belongings — while the complimentary date change removes the penalty when exam timetables or visa appointments move.

The direct-booking stack is where the savings compound. Logged-in customers booking on Air India's website or app get a 50% reduction in convenience fees, and domestic bookings paid via UPI can take up to Rs 1,000 off per passenger with the promo code UPIPROMO. For diaspora students, the one free date change on eligible international bookings is the most valuable perk: it applies to the expensive India–US/UK/Canada sectors where change fees normally run into thousands of rupees.

What's Next

Students should book on airindia.com or the Air India mobile app before the October 20 deadline to secure the flat 10% discount, select the student fare for their journey, review the fare conditions, and complete the booking. Keep the student ID and acceptance letter handy for check-in — and set a reminder: the limited-period discount disappears after October 20, though the year-round 10% fares, extra baggage, and free date change continue.
